I was moved by a second Banh Mi in one day.
May 2026 • Couples
Banh mi was served as a snack for the tour, and I wanted to eat this banh mi too, so I made it consecutive, and it came!

There were various menu items, but I didn't know anything, so I ordered the mix.
Lots of people are making banh mi! If it's like this, the service will be fast even if we wait in line! I wait while being buried in people.
The banh mi at the other shop was also delicious, but this one is packed with ingredients and the seasoning is superb! The bread was super crunchy and the best! We shared it and made it half, but it disappeared in an instant... I wish we could have lined up and eaten it again.

It’s ok
Jul 2026 • Family
This was our first time trying this banh mi, and we honestly had mixed feelings about it. 

I didn’t really understand why so many people are crazy about it. For our family, it was not that great. I think it may be catering more to people who don’t eat banh mi often, because while it wasn’t bad, it also wasn’t especially memorable. 

The sandwich itself was fine, but after standing in line for a long time, it just didn’t feel worth the wait. We expected something much better given all the hype. 

Overall, it was okay, but not something I would go out of my way to wait in line for again

Thank you
